Screen Printing for Littleton's Aerospace & South Denver Community

Littleton is a well-established south Denver suburb with a historic brick downtown, consistently top-rated schools, and one of Colorado's most notable employers in its backyard: Lockheed Martin Space Systems, which employs more than 14,000 workers across Colorado, with a large concentration in Littleton. That aerospace heritage shapes the community — professionals, families, and retirees who value quality and reliability. Local businesses, youth sports programs, and neighborhood events generate steady demand for custom apparel, custom embroidery, and branded workwear year-round.

Littleton Public Schools has received the Colorado Department of Education's highest accreditation rating more times than any other metro-area district. Its three main high schools — Littleton Lions, Heritage Eagles, and Arapahoe Warriors — run competitive athletic programs and active booster clubs with regular spirit wear and team uniform needs. Downtown Littleton's boutique retailers, the Town Hall Arts Center, and the restaurants lining Main Street also generate orders for staff uniforms and event merchandise.
